response.sql: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS mean_count FROM actor_counts), above_first AS (SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count, ac.actor_count - a.mean_count AS first_excess FROM actor_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN first_average AS a WHERE ac.actor_count > a.mean_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS mean_count FROM above_first), above_second AS (SELECT af.actor_count, af.first_excess, af.actor_count - a.mean_count AS second_excess FROM above_first AS af CROSS JOIN second_average AS a WHERE af.actor_count > a.mean_count) SELECT SUM(actor_count) AS total_actor_count, AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess FROM above_second;
